steps.name: Precondition — fresh conversation with one user message and one LLM response
Step 1 — Scroll to the last LLM response and hover: Regenerate is visible
Step 2 — Click Regenerate: old response replaced in place, new generation begins
Step 3 — In-progress state: loading/thought accordion with model label, Stop shown
Step 4 — The user's previous input is unchanged
Step 5 — The new response completes with content and the model label
